turns.prompt_text: I'm looking for a printer preferably of brother brand that is a laser printer and needs to do at least black and white and it needs to have a document scanner with an auto feed Attached 1 file. - image.png
turns.response_html:
Finding a reliable Brother laser printer with an Automatic Document Feeder (ADF) is a smart move—they are known for being absolute workhorses. Since you need monochrome (black and white) and an ADF for scanning multi-page documents, you should look specifically at the MFC (Multi-Function Center) or DCP (Digital Copier Printer) series.

Here are the best current models that fit your specific requirements:

Top Recommendations

ModelBest For...Approx. PriceKey Features
Brother MFC-L2750DWOverall Best$250 - $300Fast (36ppm), Single-pass duplex scanning (scans both sides of a page at once), and wireless printing.
Brother MFC-L2820DWCompact Value$230 - $270Newer 2024/2025 model. Compact, reliable ADF, and has a nice color touchscreen for easy scanning to cloud services.
Brother DCP-L2640DWNo-Fax Option$200 - $230If you don't need a fax line, this is usually cheaper. It has the ADF and high-quality laser printing you need.

Important Things to Consider

  • Single-Pass vs. Reversing ADF: If you scan a lot of double-sided documents, the MFC-L2750DW is superior because it has two scanning sensors and reads both sides of the paper in one go. Cheaper models with a "reversing" ADF have to physically flip the paper over, which is slower and more prone to jams.
  • The "L" Designation: Ensure the model name has an "L" (e.g., MFC-L2750). This confirms it is a Laser printer. Brother also makes "MFC-J" models, which are Inkjets—stay away from those if you want the low maintenance of laser.
  • Toner Costs: These printers use the TN730 (standard) or TN760 (high-yield) toner cartridges. One high-yield cartridge can last for about 3,000 pages, which is perfect for heavy schoolwork or home office use.

A Pro-Tip for Your Setup

Since you have a chameleon as your wallpaper (nice setup, by the way!), keep in mind that laser printers generate a bit of heat and ozone during large print jobs. It’s usually best to keep the printer in a well-ventilated spot, especially if it’s in the same room as a sensitive pet like a veiled or panther chameleon.
